marginalia.note: Non habetur loco citato lex, sed pœna denuntiatio.

page.notes: The asterisk reference in the text is marked {*}; its marginal note is printed beside the line "lex cujusvis". "tesant" is doubtful (possibly printed error for "terant"). The marginal note's line breaks were read as "Non habe- / tur loco citato / lex, sed pœna / denuntiatio." The long s has been rendered as plain s throughout. "Genes.3.17" is the printed citation.
